mean_slope_deg.label: Mean Slope
mean_slope_deg.description: Mean terrain slope measuring topographic steepness and traverse difficulty.

terrain_ruggedness_tri.label: Terrain Ruggedness (TRI)
terrain_ruggedness_tri.description: Terrain Ruggedness Index capturing localized boulder fields, craters, and ravines.

sar_roughness_db.label: SAR Backscatter Roughness
sar_roughness_db.description: Radar backscatter cross-section measuring wavelength-scale regolith roughness.

sar_depolarization_ratio.label: SAR Depolarization (VH/VV)
sar_depolarization_ratio.description: Cross-polarization ratio indicating blocky volcanic rubble and volume scattering.

diurnal_delta_t_c.label: Diurnal Thermal Swing
diurnal_delta_t_c.description: Day-to-night temperature swing indicating thermal inertia and regolith conductivity.

min_temp_c.label: Minimum Night Temperature
min_temp_c.description: 5th percentile nighttime ground temperature testing cryogenic endurance.

iron_oxide_index.label: Ferric Iron Oxide Index
iron_oxide_index.description: Spectroscopic band ratio tracking oxidized ferric regolith and hematite coatings.

basalt_mafic_index.label: Basaltic Mafic Index
basalt_mafic_index.description: Combined SWIR and thermal infrared ratio indicating pyroxene/olivine basaltic crust.

cluster_taxonomy.name: Hyper-Arid Ferric Regolith
cluster_taxonomy.description: High iron-oxide, extreme diurnal swings, low moisture. Strong Mars Jezero/Meridiani analog.

cluster_taxonomy.name: Basaltic Lava Fields & Tubes
cluster_taxonomy.description: Low silica, high pyroxene/olivine, high radar depolarization. Strong Moon Marius/Mare analog.

cluster_taxonomy.name: Cryo-Periglacial Deserts
cluster_taxonomy.description: Sub-zero temperatures, patterned ground, high altitude/latitude. Strong Moon PSR / Mars Arcadia analog.

cluster_taxonomy.name: Steep Impact / Escarpment Slopes
cluster_taxonomy.description: High slope angles (>20°), high TRI ruggedness, boulder scree. Strong Shackleton / Valles Marineris analog.

cluster_taxonomy.name: Evaporite & Sulfate Salt Flats
cluster_taxonomy.description: Smooth specular radar backscatter, layered sulfates, paleolake beds. Strong ancient lacustrine analog.

sites.name: Haughton Impact Crater
sites.geological_summary: 23-km meteorite impact structure in cold, dry polar desert. Shocked dolomite, shatter cones, and impact melt breccia.
sites.target_mission_relevance: NASA HMP (Haughton-Mars Project) active since 1997 for spacesuit mobility, rover traverse, and drill testing.

sites.name: Atacama Desert (Yungay Hyper-Arid Core)
sites.geological_summary: Hyper-arid desert untouched by rain for decades. Perchlorate and nitrate salts, dry clay-poor soils, biological threshold limit.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Viking, Phoenix, and Curiosity instrument calibration testbed for organic detection and soil moisture sensors.

sites.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys (University Valley)
sites.geological_summary: Coldest, driest polar desert on Earth. Ice-table buried beneath 5-15 cm of dry regolith, zero liquid water, ventifacts.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Ground truth for Mars permafrost polygon modeling and cryogenic ice-coring drill test campaigns.

sites.name: Askja Caldera & Ódáðahraun Lava Field
sites.geological_summary: Extensive Holocene basaltic lava fields, pumice fall deposits, and nested calderas with minimal soil development.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Historical Apollo 11/12 astronaut geology field training grounds; ESA/NASA rover autonomous navigation trials.

sites.name: Kilauea & Mauna Ulu Lava Fields
sites.primary_analog_target: Moon Mare Basalts & Mars Volcanic Plains
sites.geological_summary: Tholeiitic basaltic pahoehoe and 'a'a lava flows, volcanic skylights, active rifting, olivine-rich regolith.
sites.target_mission_relevance: NASA BASALT project testing tactical EVA science operational architectures and handheld spectrometer tools.

sites.name: Lava Beds National Monument
sites.primary_analog_target: Moon Marius Hills & Mars Lava Tubes
sites.geological_summary: High concentration of volcanic basalt caves, collapsed pit craters, tube rilles, and smooth tube interiors.
sites.target_mission_relevance: NASA BRAILLE and Biologic Rover teams testing underground robotic exploration, LiDAR slam, and speleothem biosignatures.

sites.name: Pilot Valley Playa
sites.geological_summary: Closed-basin carbonate-evaporite playa with high salinity, localized smectite clays, and groundwater discharge zones.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Field trials for Mars 2020 SHERLOC deep-UV Raman spectroscopy and endolithic biomarker identification.

sites.name: Barringer Meteor Crater
sites.geological_summary: 1.2-km diameter simple bowl-shaped impact crater in Coconino sandstone and Kaibab limestone with continuous ejecta blanket.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Classic NASA astronaut training ground; crater ejecta distribution and rover slope ascent/descent test site.

sites.name: Lake Salda Hydromagnesite Shoreline
sites.geological_summary: Deep alkaline lake surrounded by white hydromagnesite microbialites and serpentinized ultramafic bedrock.
sites.target_mission_relevance: NASA Perseverance science team prime mineralogical and morphological analog for Jezero crater marginal carbonates.

sites.name: Rio Tinto Acidic Iron-Sulfate River
sites.geological_summary: Extremely acidic river system (pH ~2) precipitating goethite, jarosite, and hematite deposits from sulfide weathering.
sites.target_mission_relevance: MARTE project and ESA tests for robotic subsurface drilling and acid-tolerant biosignature extraction.

sites.name: Lonar Impact Crater in Deccan Basalt
sites.geological_summary: Only hyper-velocity meteorite impact crater on Earth formed entirely within continental flood basalt (Deccan Traps).
sites.target_mission_relevance: Prime analog for shock metamorphism in basalt (maskelynite formation) identical to lunar and martian cratered plains.

sites.name: Tso Kar Permafrost & Salt Basin
sites.geological_summary: High-altitude hyper-cold saline basin in the Tibetan Plateau rainshadow. Permafrost mounds, borax, and mirabilite evaporites.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) & NASA Spaceward analog candidate for extreme cold-arid rover mechanics.

sites.name: Matanomadh Jarosite & Alunite Beds
sites.primary_analog_target: Mars Mawrth Vallis & Meridiani Planum Sulfates
sites.geological_summary: Extensive acidic weathering of Deccan basalts producing jarosite, alunite, hematite, and smectite clay stratigraphy.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Investigated by planetary geologists as one of Earth's closest spectral matches to Martian jarosite-bearing outcrops.

sites.name: Danakil Depression (Dallol Hydrothermal)
sites.geological_summary: Tectonic spreading rift with hyper-saline, hyper-acidic boiling springs precipitating iron oxides, sulfur, and potash salts.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Europlanet / NASA extreme astrobiology benchmark exploring limits of habitability and iron-oxide mineral paragenesis.

sites.name: Namib Sand Sea Linear Megadunes
sites.primary_analog_target: Mars Aeolian Dune Fields & Titan Dunes
sites.geological_summary: Extensive hyper-arid coastal erg with 300-meter high linear and star dunes composed of quartz sand coated in hematite iron oxide.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Aeolian dynamics testbed for Curiosity and Perseverance dune traversal, wheel-sinkage slip models, and wind-blown dust sensors.

sites.name: Spiti Valley High-Altitude Periglacial Shales
sites.geological_summary: Zero-vegetation cold mountain desert with shattered Tethyan marine sedimentary shales, scree slopes, and extreme freeze-thaw cycles.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Unrecognized candidate for testing Mars steep-slope scree traversal, unweathered rock fracturing, and high-UV solar degradation.

sites.name: Dhinodhar Volcanic Basalt Plug
sites.primary_analog_target: Moon Volcanic Cones & Mars Intrusive Plugs
sites.geological_summary: Prominent Jurassic sandstone intruded by a columnar basalt volcanic neck standing high above hyper-saline desert plains.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Ideal unrecognized site for basalt column extraction, steep volcanic ascent, and combined radar backscatter calibration.

sites.name: Pic Tousside & Trou au Natron Caldera
sites.geological_summary: Active volcanic dome surrounded by a 1,000-meter deep caldera encrusted with bright white sodium carbonate evaporites and black basalt tephra.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Unexplored high-contrast planetary analog for caldera wall rover descent, volcanic gas sensors, and pyroclastic glass sampling.

sites.name: Waw an Namus Basaltic Ash Caldera
sites.geological_summary: Caldera encircled by a 10-20 km wide apron of jet-black volcanic basaltic ash and scoria standing in stark contrast to yellow Sahara sands.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Extraordinary terrestrial match for lunar dark mantle deposits and loose fine-grained basalt ash mobility testing.

sites.name: Dasht-e Lut Mega-Yardangs (Kaluts)
sites.geological_summary: Hottest surface temperature recorded on Earth (~70°C). Colossal aerodynamic wind-carved ridge corridors carved into cohesive silts.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Crucial analog for Mars aeolian corridor navigation, thermal protection system stress-testing, and yardang slip management.

sites.name: Puna de Atacama (Salar de Arizaro Barren)
sites.primary_analog_target: Mars Acidic Evaporites & Cono de Arita
sites.geological_summary: Gigantic high-altitude salt flat with jagged halite crusts, black basalt rubble, and the mysterious volcanic pyramid of Cono de Arita.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Superior analog for Martian high-altitude UV radiation, knife-sharp salt crust wheel wear, and cryogenic night-time operations.

sites.name: Harrat Khaybar White Volcanoes
sites.geological_summary: Rare felsic comendite white lava domes (Jabal Abyad) rising abruptly out of a sea of black basaltic scoria fields and fissures.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Unmatched terrestrial comparison for non-mare silicic volcanic constructs on the Moon (Compton-Belkovich thorium anomaly).

sites.name: Hoggar Atakor Volcanic Plugs
sites.primary_analog_target: Moon Central Peaks & Mars Volcanic Spires
sites.geological_summary: Hundreds of sheer phonolite and basalt volcanic needles and spires piercing a high-elevation Precambrian metamorphic shield.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Ideal for autonomous vertical wall mapping, tethered anchor systems, and complex radar shadow deconvolution.

sites.name: Mangystau Plateau & Sor Tuzbair
sites.geological_summary: Extensive blinding white chalk cliffs, residual mesa towers, and deep saline mud sor basins in cold continental desert.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Exceptional for Mars layered sedimentary cliff navigation, optical camera auto-exposure stress, and soft sediment coring.

sites.name: Pilbara Craton Banded Iron Formations
sites.geological_summary: 3.5-billion-year-old Archean crust rich in banded iron formation (BIF), massive hematite, jasper, and earliest fossil stromatolites.
sites.target_mission_relevance: The gold-standard mineralogical match for Martian oxidized surface regolith and high-density magnetic regolith handling.

sites.name: Changthang Cold Desert Plateau
sites.geological_summary: Endless barren gravel plains with patterned permafrost stone nets, sub-zero winds, and intense cosmic radiation.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Human habitat thermal insulation validation and long-range autonomous rover autonomy over frozen gravel plains.

sites.name: Richat Structure (Eye of the Sahara)
sites.geological_summary: 40-km wide deeply eroded geological dome exposing concentric rings of resistant Proterozoic quartzite and intrusive carbonatites.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Large-scale terrain mapping, satellite orbital landmark tracking, and multi-spectral lithological classification.

sites.name: Al-Lajjun Basaltic Plateau & Graben
sites.geological_summary: Neogene basalt sheets capping bituminous marls with desert varnish, wind-scoured basalt pebbles, and shallow drainage rilles.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Superb site for basaltic gravel wheel slip, rock-abrasion tool testing, and dust electrostatic accumulation tests.

sites.name: Qaidam Basin Yardangs & Saline Dunefield
sites.primary_analog_target: Mars Medusae Fossae & Gale Crater Plains
sites.geological_summary: Hyper-arid, high-elevation cold basin hosting the world's most extensive continuous field of wind-sculpted yardangs and sulfate flats.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Unexplored high-latitude Mars analog for rover navigation through maze-like wind corridors and hyper-dry sulfate coring.

sites.name: Makhtesh Ramon Erosion Cirque
sites.primary_analog_target: Mars Valles Marineris Floor & Basalt Dykes
sites.geological_summary: 40-km long geological crater formed by subterranean karst drainage collapse exposing triassic-jurassic basalt dykes and red clays.
sites.target_mission_relevance: D-MARS simulated analog habitat site; outstanding terrain for autonomous geological scouting and cliff-face sample capture.

sites.name: Timanfaya Volcanic Malpaís
sites.geological_summary: Pristine historical 1730-1736 basaltic fissure eruption fields with zero vegetation, hornitos, lava tubes, and cinder cones.
sites.target_mission_relevance: ESA PANGAEA training ground; razor-sharp aa lava tire durability evaluation and underground tube entry testing.

sites.name: Craters of the Moon Great Rift Lava
sites.geological_summary: Extensive Holocene basaltic flood field with open fissures, rafted blocks, spatter cones, and extensive underground lava tubes.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Original Apollo 14 astronaut basalt identification field site; rover chassis clearance and obstacle negotiation testbed.

sites.name: Death Valley Badwater Salt Polygon Crust
sites.geological_summary: Lowest point in North America. Expansive self-healing halite salt polygons, gypsum crusts, and hyper-saline groundwater capillary action.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Testing rover wheel traction on jagged salt ridges and testing thermal stability under extreme ambient heat.

sites.name: White Sands Gypsum Dunefield
sites.primary_analog_target: Mars Olympia Undae Polar Gypsum Erg
sites.geological_summary: World's largest gypsum (hydrated calcium sulfate) dunefield, high albedo, cool-to-touch sands with subsurface moisture.
sites.target_mission_relevance: High-fidelity analog for northern circumpolar gypsum dunes on Mars; testing hydration state remote sensing.

sites.name: Salar de Uyuni Lithium & Salt Crust
sites.geological_summary: 10,500 sq km flat salt sheet of lithium, potassium, magnesium, and halite crusts under intense Andean UV radiation.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Global primary Earth target for satellite laser altimeter calibration (ICESat, LOLA) and long-baseline rover navigation.

sites.name: Skeiðarársandur Glacial Basalt Outwash
sites.geological_summary: Enormous volcanic basalt sand plain formed by jökulhlaup (subglacial volcanic catastrophic floods). Fine black sands and braiding.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Martian catastrophic flood sedimentation analog, fine basalt sand wheel slip, and hydraulic sorting of volcanic ash.

sites.name: Alvord Desert Dry Bed Playa
sites.geological_summary: Dried pluvial lake bed nestled under Steens Mountain basalt fault scarp. Extremely flat, hard-packed alkaline clay silt surface.
sites.target_mission_relevance: High-speed rover sprint testing, ground-penetrating radar calibration, and dust devil vortex formation tracking.

sites.name: Black Rock Desert Alkali Playa
sites.geological_summary: Extensive silt and clay playa lake remnant of Pleistocene Lake Lahontan surrounded by volcanic rhyolite mountain ranges.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Ideal for testing high-altitude rocket recovery, autonomous long-range rover navigation, and fine particulate adhesion.

sites.name: Simpson Desert Iron Regolith & Dunes
sites.geological_summary: World's longest parallel sand dunes stained intensely red by hematite iron oxide coatings over ancient claypans.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Martian red planet terrain replica; traction testing across deep loose iron-coated sands and inter-dune hard claypans.

sites.name: Kati Thanda-Lake Eyre Endorheic Basin
sites.geological_summary: Massive inland salt sink, thick crust of halite and gypsum covering soft mud, surrounded by gibber plains (desert pavement).
sites.target_mission_relevance: Rover wheel sinkage hazards (perched crust over mud), salt coring drills, and long-range remote telemetry.

sites.name: Valle de la Luna (Valley of the Moon)
sites.geological_summary: Extravagant foldings of red clay, gypsum, and halite sculpted by flash floods and persistent winds in hyper-arid Atacama.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Rover optical depth estimation in high-contrast shadow canyons and micro-topography obstacle avoidance.

sites.name: Badain Jaran Stationary Megadunes
sites.geological_summary: World's tallest stationary sand megadunes (up to 500 meters high) with subterranean water table feeding hyper-saline interdune lakes.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Steep sand slip-face climbing algorithms, wheel slip prevention, and aeolian sounding radar testing.

sites.name: Rub' al Khali (Empty Quarter Sand Seas)
sites.primary_analog_target: Mars Unbroken Sand Seas & Titan Dunes
sites.geological_summary: Largest continuous sand desert on Earth. Immense barchan and longitudinal dunes with high-purity quartz-hematite grains.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Testing autonomous long-range rover power consumption over continuous sand terrain under harsh solar flux.

sites.name: Dasht-e Kavir Great Salt Desert
sites.geological_summary: Extensive salt diapirs, thick salt marshes, and dry mud polygons subjected to high evaporation and sparse rainfall.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Validating salt dome mineralogy, subsurface brines detection using Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR).

sites.name: Erfoud Desert Regolith & Devonian Beds
sites.geological_summary: Rocky desert hamada with dense dark gravel pavements over fossiliferous limestone and oxidized red clays.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Used frequently by Austrian Space Forum (ÖWF) and Europlanet for Mars rover simulation and suit mobility.

sites.name: Lake Mungo Pleistocene Lunette
sites.geological_summary: Ancient dried lake bed flanked by a 30-km crescent-shaped lunette dune ('Walls of China') composed of layered clays and sand.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Aqueous-to-arid transition stratigraphy, mudstone erosion analysis, and delicate soil sample coring.

sites.name: Uunartoq Cold Periglacial Barren
sites.geological_summary: Glacially scoured bedrock, scree talus slopes, permafrost weathering, and complete lack of vegetation.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Cryogenic rover battery efficiency tests and ice-rock interface drilling.

sites.name: Truelove Lowland Permafrost Terraces
sites.geological_summary: Post-glacial raised beach terraces in polar desert with continuous permafrost and patterned ice-wedge polygons.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Automated ice-wedge detection, polygon geometry analysis, and ground-ice sublimation tracking.

sites.name: Expedition Fjord Gypsum & Anhydrite Diapirs
sites.primary_analog_target: Mars Cold Saline Springs & Gypsum Domes
sites.geological_summary: Rare sub-zero perennial saline springs emanating through thick permafrost associated with massive piercement gypsum diapirs.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Direct analog for cold springs on Mars and subsurface cryogenic brine conduit exploration.

sites.name: Bockfjorden Volcanic Complex
sites.geological_summary: Quaternary basaltic volcanic cones erupting through ancient basement rocks hosting unique sub-arctic travertine hot springs.
sites.target_mission_relevance: AMASE (Arctic Mars Analog Svalbard Expedition) heritage; rover mineralogy payloads detecting biogenic carbonates in basalt.

sites.name: Bromo Caldera Laut Pasir (Sand Sea)
sites.geological_summary: Vast flat caldera floor covered in fine volcanic ash and tephra ('Sea of Sand') bounded by active volcanic degassing vents.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Fine volcanic dust filtration, high-altitude optical navigation, and tephra wheel sinkage.

sites.name: SP Crater & Black Basalt Lava Flow
sites.primary_analog_target: Moon Cinder Cones & Mars Blocky Basalt
sites.geological_summary: Striking cinder cone with a 7-km long blocky basaltic aa lava flow with exceptionally high radar roughness.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Apollo field training heritage; blocky lava traverse, high-resolution SAR roughness calibration.

sites.name: Zuni-Bandera Lava Tube Caves
sites.geological_summary: Cenozoic volcanic field hosting Bandera Ice Cave where subterranean ice survives year-round inside basalt tubes.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Unexplored analog for permanent lunar lava tube ice traps and autonomous cave mapping robotics.

sites.name: Carrizozo Malpais Basalt Flow
sites.geological_summary: 75-km long basaltic pahoehoe flow, one of the youngest in the United States (~5,000 years old). Pristine pressure ridges and collapsed pits.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Rover obstacle navigation over convoluted basaltic ropy lava, crack detection, and antenna propagation.

sites.name: Great Sand Dunes Mountain-Trapped Erg
sites.geological_summary: Tallest dunes in North America trapped against the Sangre de Cristo mountain scarp, high diurnal temperature swings.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Testing high-altitude thin-atmosphere drone rotor aerodynamics and steep slipface traction.

sites.name: Salar del Hombre Muerto Halite Crust
sites.geological_summary: Puna plateau salt flat with thick halite polygon terraces, lithium brines, and strong winds producing dry dust storms.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Testing drill ingress through crystalline salt layers and battery cold performance in thin mountain air.

sites.name: Salar de Coipasa Gypsum & Volcanic Border
sites.geological_summary: Extensive salt lake entirely encircled by volcanic cones, creating mixed volcanic-evaporite sediment beds.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Spectroscopic differentiation between basaltic volcanic sediments and evaporite sulfate salts.

sites.name: Laguna Colorada Borax & Extreme UV Basin
sites.geological_summary: Shallow salt lake with brilliant red sediment caused by pigmentation of extremophile halophilic algae and white borax islands.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Biosignature optical detection against high mineral background and solar UV radiation hardened sensors.

sites.name: Borax Lake Geothermal Mud Pots
sites.geological_summary: Perched geothermal mineral spring system depositing arsenic and sodium borate deposits in an arid pluvial basin.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Arsenic-tolerant and mineralized biosignature identification algorithms for rover Raman spectrometers.

sites.name: Bisti/De-Na-Zin Shales & Coal Ash Badlands
sites.region_country: San Juan County, New Mexico, USA
sites.geological_summary: Striking badland wilderness of eroded interbedded sandstones, mudstones, bentonite clay, and oxidized coal ash beds.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Testing autonomous rover path planning through dense labyrinthine pinnacle fields and brittle clay crusts.

sites.name: San Rafael Swell Inverted River Channels
sites.geological_summary: Classic exhumed fluvial channel sandstones standing as elevated sinuous ridges above deeply eroded softer mudstones.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Morphological analog for Jezero and Aeolis Dorsa inverted river channels; testing ridge-top rover traverse.

sites.name: Hanksville Morrison Formation Clay Mesas
sites.primary_analog_target: Mars Gale Crater Hematite & Clay Ridge
sites.geological_summary: Extensive bentonite clay hills that swell into slippery 'popcorn' mud when wet, layered with iron-rich sandstone ledges.
sites.target_mission_relevance: Testing wheel grout adhesion and torque control over expansive montmorillonite/bentonite swelling clays.

sites.name: Jabal Gharyan Basalt Sill & Red Soils
sites.primary_analog_target: Mars Volcanic Sill & Deep Red Regolith
sites.geological_summary: Mesozoic basaltic volcanic sills cutting through intense red lateritic desert paleosols and escarpments.
sites.target_mission_relevance: High iron-oxide index and basaltic mixture analog for Martian volcanic plains with oxidized dust mantles.
